name: Ask
desc: Ask the user a few short questions before running.

name: Mark the area
desc: Use a saved place or ask the user to draw or upload one.

name: Pick dates
desc: Recent window plus the same window in past years.

name: Pick the satellite
desc: Route to free sources first; paid only if the area is too small.

name: Find clear images
desc: Skip cloudy scenes and scenes right after rain.

name: Clean the images
desc: Clip to the area and mask clouds and shadows.

name: Calculate indices
desc: Spectral indices such as NDVI, NDMI, NDWI or LST.

name: Find anomalies
desc: Zones far from the area median on N or more dates.

name: Find changes
desc: Compare each date with a baseline and list changes.

name: Find the cause
desc: Check elevation, soil and weather to suggest a cause.

name: Show the answer
desc: Map layers, key numbers with confidence ranges, next steps.

name: Keep watching
desc: Re-run on each new pass and alert on a condition.
